site_tagline: EV charging prices in Iceland — in one place
tesla_price_only_title: This price applies to Tesla cars. Other cars may pay a different price.
trends_note: Each line shows a network's lowest price per kWh over time. History begins when collection started, 2026.
station_host_priced: The site owner sets the price here, not {network}.
map_fallback: The map could not load in this browser.
avail_partial: TomTom reports {total} of {all} stalls — the other {unknown} have no live status
map_js: The map needs JavaScript — the station list on the homepage works without it.
estimate_note: ≈ marks an estimate for charging from 10 % to 80 % ({kwh} kWh usable battery). The data has no charging curves, so on DC the average power is assumed to be about 60 % of the car's peak (or 90 % of the charger's rating if it is slower). A real charge can be faster or slower. Charging losses are not included.
estimate_note_no_battery: The car's battery size is missing from the data, so no charging cost is estimated.
sorted_by_effective: Sorted by price including per-minute fees for this car.
sorted_by_distance: Sorted by distance from your location (rounded to about 100 m).
search_label: Search stations by name or town
near_denied: The browser was not allowed to use your location. You can allow it in the browser settings, or search by town.
near_unavailable: Your location could not be found. Try again, or search by town.
near_unsupported: This browser does not support location. Search by town instead.
